scientific_integrity: The analytic proof is explicit and covers every stated field; finite computational checks corroborate rather than prove it. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for finite fields of characteristic greater than five. Exact additive energy and constant-input Fourier fourth moment, not the unrestricted sharp extension norm; characteristic eleven is singular. Prior-art uncertainty remains.
title: Elliptic-trace formula and a characteristic-eleven jump for the sextic finite-field graph
